definitions.explanation: in geometry, refers to a line connecting opposite corners or the angles at opposite corners

examples.japanese: ⟦{正方形|せいほうけい}→正方形：05438_seihoukei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対角|たいかく}{線|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: Draw a diagonal line on a square.

examples.japanese: {対角|たいかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移動|いどう}する→移動する：22430_idousuru⟧。
examples.english: Move to the diagonally opposite corner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平行四辺形|へいこうしへんけい}→平行四辺形：23382_heikoushihenkei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対角|たいかく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{等|ひと}しい→等しい：03710_hitoshii⟧。
examples.english: The opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal.

notes:
A geometry term referring to opposite corners/angles of a shape, or the diagonal line connecting them.

FORMS:
⟦{対|たい}→対：03382_tai⟧ (opposite/facing) + {角|かく} (angle/corner)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{対角線|たいかくせん}→対角線：08121_taikakusen⟧: diagonal line (connecting opposite corners)
- {対角|たいかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: located diagonally opposite

RELATED GEOMETRY TERMS:
- {対辺|たいへん}: opposite side
- ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧{角|かく}: adjacent angle
- ⟦{正方形|せいほうけい}→正方形：05438_seihoukei⟧: square
- ⟦{長方形|ちょうほうけい}→長方形：05439_chouhoukei⟧: rectangle

USAGE:
Primarily used in mathematics education and technical contexts. Also used outside geometry to describe something located diagonally across — for example, ⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対角|たいかく} (diagonally across the intersection).
